invariant: A printable-ASCII character in a Helvetica style slot uses that slot's own glyph advance from Helvetica.ttc, scaled by point size / 2048.
causal_divergence: The old upright tables collapsed five face advances onto shared constants: plain % 1820 against 1821, apostrophe 455 against 391, W 1934 against 1933, bold k 1251 against 1139, bold z 1251 against 1024.
planned_change: Replace the upright Helvetica tables with the four extracted ASCII faces and select the slot the way Verdana and Arial do. Keep U+00AB and U+00BB at the previous 1139 units until a checked cmap extraction replaces them. Do not retarget Times, Courier, Menlo or Lucida.
